title: unified-rollouts-enhance-canary-shadow-autorollback-observability
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Improve observability and safety around canary / shadow rollouts and automated rollback workflows. Users asked for clearer metric matching, diagnostic traces for rollback decisions, and per-rollout dashboards so SREs can quickly validate canary behavior before and after automatic rollbacks.

This PR: adds richer telemetry to the unified rollouts controller, surfaces rollback signals to tracing and dashboards, improves metric matching heuristics used by autorollback policies, and wires up alert-friendly tags to make SLO/alert rules simpler. Includes unit and integration tests and a small e2e canary scenario for the controller test harness.

Checklist:
- [x] Instrument controller with rollback_reason and matching_metric tags
- [x] Add new observability docs and dashboard templates
- [x] Improve metric matcher to prefer stable window and ignore cold-start spikes
- [x] Emit trace spans for probe evaluation and decision points
- [x] Add e2e stability guard tests for staged shadow canary
- [x] Add migration guide for dashboards and queries

Notes: Linear tasks ENG-2145 and ENG-2189 track the metric-matching work and dashboard templates. This is intentionally conservative: we do not change rollout default thresholds, only the telemetry and matching behavior. Backwards compatibility: rollout policy schemas are unchanged, new telemetry is additive.

Implementation summary: changed the rollout controller decision path to annotate spans with policy id, candidate model version, and the set of metrics evaluated; refactored metric matcher into a smaller, testable module; added a short-lived, high-cardinality tag set that is scrubbed before long-term metric export; added Grafana JSON templates and an example Alertmanager rule tied to the rollback_reason tag.

Merge: squash-merged after approvals and green CI.
